summary: The old harness clears XML_PARSE_DTDVALID before every parser route, while both source versions support DTD validation through that option.

claims.necessity_reason: DTD validation is a supported XML parsing behavior. A fuzz input can supply an XML document and request the option, but the harness clears the option before parsing, leaving option-selected validation unreachable.

before.requirement: Pass XML_PARSE_DTDVALID to the XML parser when the input requests DTD validation.
before.reason: The source accepts XML_PARSE_DTDVALID and derives the parser context's validation state from it. The harness clears the bit before passing options to the parser.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The pull parser applies the options supplied by the harness before parsing.

after.requirement: Pass XML_PARSE_DTDVALID to the XML parser when the input requests DTD validation.
after.reason: The source still accepts XML_PARSE_DTDVALID and derives validation state from it. The same harness still clears the bit.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The pull parser applies the options supplied by the harness before parsing.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The push parser receives the same masked options.
The reader receives the same masked options.
Input entity pairs can supply the XML document to the parser routes.

claims.comparison_reason: The same XML_PARSE_DTDVALID mask prevents option-selected validation on both sides.
